column1: # Partition table — 4MB flash with dual OTA + SPIFFS (SECURE variant)
# Sibling to ota_4mb.csv. Used only by [env:secure] (secure boot v2 +
# Layout follows ota_4mb.csv so a fielded dash running an unsigned image
# and a future dash running this signed image share the same on-flash
# partition geometry. That makes the migration to secure boot a one-shot
# USB reflash on the production-flash workstation without first rebuilding
#   - nvs shrunk 20 KB → 16 KB to make room for the 4 KB nvs_keys partition
#   - nvs_keys (4 KB) added at 0xd000 — holds the encrypted-NVS key
#     (encrypted under the chip's flash encryption key)
#     Espressif's ROM reads them in the clear)
